names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ισάκιος, Ιωάννης, Σαβώριος, Ωνάμ, Παππίας και Ισαάκιος», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the clause for 20 ноября ст. ст., name page 961, «Иоанн Бет-Селевкийский (Персидский), сщмч.», with the grade word left off. **This form folds**, and the fold is the evidence: `john-companion-of-james-the-presbyter` holds the identical string off the same name page read for 1 ноября ст. ст. Two folders, one name page, one life. The fold is written rather than hidden so that the author can see the two from either end.

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι τρεις πρώτοι μαρτύρησαν δια λιθοβολισμού το 343 μ.Χ. μαζί με τον ασκητή Ωνάμ, από τον βασιλιά των Περσών», and the page's own heading carries «(; - 343)» against this name. It gives no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Нирсы еп. и Иосифа, ученика его, Иоанна, Саверия, Исакия и Ипатия, епископов Персидских; мч. Азата скопца, Сасония, Феклы, Анны и иных многих мужей и жен, в Персиде пострадавших (343).»

attestations.note: **His name page is listed on two days and this corpus keeps two folders for them.** Name page 961 prints «Дни памяти: 1 ноября , 20 ноября», and behind both of them the one Persian life, life2574, in which a bishop John is stoned. The row for 1 ноября is already written, on `john-companion-of-james-the-presbyter`, and its own note records that the 20 ноября was seen and refused there because deciding that two commemorations are one man is not a reader’s. This row is the other half of that refusal: it is written here, on the folder the Greek calendar made for this very company on this very day, and the two folders are left standing. If the author merges them, one of these two rows goes.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (2 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ισάκιος, Ιωάννης, Σαβώριος, Ωνάμ, Παππίας και Ισαάκιος»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3048/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The line enumerates six men by name, so there is a folder for each, and the six share one life. The same day keeps a second John, `john-of-nitria`, an ascetic of Nitria on his own page, who is a different man on a different notice; the display name takes the day for that reason and because the corpus keeps very many of this name. The page's long heading block on the name ΙΩΑΝΝΗΣ lists the Forerunner, the Evangelist and Chrysostom as famous bearers; it is that site's gloss on any name and says nothing about this man, and nothing of it is recorded here. The page notes that in the Paris Codices 1578 and 1624 they are called bishops; it gives them no see, so no `office` is recorded. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
